title: Identification of the normalized integral comparison with the evaluation-defined map.
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g and permitted integral Hom pair P, the evaluation-defined partial Hom comparison podPartialHomComparison equals the component of the normalized integral comparison integralComparison.

source.place: Steps 8--11: identify the normalized comparison with the evaluation-defined comparison

proof.text: Expand the completion-unit normalization of integralComparison and the defining transpose formula of podIntegralClosed. Parameter naturality and the canonical tensor comparison identify the two inverse transposes. Since closed transposition is an additive equivalence, the arrows are equal.

mathlib_searches.query: equality of closed transpose maps from equality of inverse transposes
mathlib_searches.results: No project-specific completed declaration; use the stated normalization and additive equivalence.
No Mathlib declaration for project structures.
The identification is a new strict component statement.

theorem podIntegralHomComparison_eq_integralComparison :
    ∀ P : (constructibleIntegralHomPairs l E Y).FullSubcategory,
      podPartialHomComparison (podIntegralClosed l E Y) (podIntegralClosed l E X)
        (constructibleIntegralPullback l E g) (podIntegralPairs_pullback l E g)
          (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g) P =
        (PodCoefficientDescent.integralComparison l E g).hom.app P
